name: RestaurantOS
postCreateCommand: bun install --frozen-lockfile && cp .env.example .env && sed -i 's/WEBAUTHN_ENABLED="false"/WEBAUTHN_ENABLED="true"/' .env && bun run db:generate && node scripts/init-pglite.mjs
postStartCommand: cd /workspaces/restaurantos && nohup bun run dev > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 & sleep 45 && curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/ > /tmp/http-status.txt && gh codespace ports visibility 3000:public -c $CODESPACE_NAME 2>/dev/null; echo DONE > /tmp/start-done.txt
